candidate.user_input: How can I indicate my availability as a mentor on the GitLab team page?
candidate.reference: You can indicate your mentorship availability on the GitLab team page by setting the `mentor` status to `true`, which will display a line that reads `Available as a mentor` on the team page.
reference_contexts:
## Become a mentor

1. Indicate your mentorship availability on the GitLab team page by setting the `mentor` status to `true`. This will appear on the team page with a line that reads `Available as a mentor`. [Example MR](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/www-gitlab-com/-/merge_requests/75890)
